reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread and told her to hold off putting 261 in the tracker. The figure for today is 185 seats, and it goes to 230 on 2027-01-01.

- **Where 261 came from:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on the 14th, but nothing in the signed paperwork backs it up. I also accepted it as "noted" back then without checking, and I said so in the thread.
- **Why 185 today:** The 2026 renewal order form (signed 2026-03-20, renews 2027-03-31) doesn't state a seat count, so the earlier count carries over. Amendment No. 1 set that at 185; Dana corrected her own 180 to 185 in the channel in Aug 2025. The account page still shows 185 active seats.
- **The change to 230:** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230, effective only from 2027-01-01.

I asked Ilse in the thread where 261 comes from. I left out the order form's price and discount because others in the channel can read it.
